proofs.label: a different padlock
reasons: Couldn't confirm this is the same padlock. Photo B is not the same physical padlock as Photo A. Both are old dark rusted iron padlocks with an arched shackle, but the body construction is fundamentally different. A has an ornate wide lobed body with side notches, four circular holes/openings and a central cover plate with an irregular bottom projection. B has a plain rectangular block body with no holes, no plate, straight sides and a flat bottom. The shackle shape and silhouette also differ, with A showing a short shackle with a rivet. These are two different objects of similar type.
